notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
​The Voyeur rework:


 It's harder for Voyeur to spawn on top of you
 Now you can move while Voyeur is present
 Improved looking algorithm
 Spawned Voyeur further into the game (Around 01 AM)


Some more fixes

 Slowed the pace of the game so enemies don't overwhelm
 Updated annotations on the PC
 Fixed some more bound-related bugs
 Improved performance
 Added skip to cutscenes (Escape)
 Better buttons in the puzzles
 Some minor bugs with the "Simon Says" puzzle


Upcoming

 French and Chinese translation
 Death animations for the enemies
 More calibration to other modes
 Key rebinds

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Improved readability.
 Added a new "Hint" menu to the computer
 Bigger outline for interactive items
 Fixed some spelling


Unless omething bigger happens, I will move my focus to the Linux version and some more localization.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Removed the all-hated math puzzle
 Added language selection in addition to automatic detection
 Fixed some bounds problems
 Improved flesh shader


Also I'd like to announce some more support to the game. For now, in addition to bugfixes we will add:


 Linux support
 French language
 Future languages too


Thanks for the support on launch
